_comment: Markdownlint config tuned for this content-heavy skill. Rules disabled or relaxed below are commented inline.
_MD013: line-length — disabled because our prose, tables, and code blocks legitimately exceed 80/120 chars; enforcement adds noise without value.
_MD024: no-duplicate-heading — siblings_only allows the repeated `### Added` / `### Changed` headings across CHANGELOG versions.
_MD025: single-h1 — CHANGELOG-style files legitimately have multiple top-level entries; the docs also embed sample requirements documents that start with their own H1.
_MD033: no-inline-html — allow the small set of HTML used for the README hero banner and the occasional inline highlighting.
_MD034: no-bare-urls — bibliographic citations occasionally show bare URLs (lattes, orcid) on purpose. Linkifying every one would clutter the prose.
_MD036: no-emphasis-as-heading — we use `**bold**` for in-paragraph emphasis (Brazilian domain terms in *italic+quotes*, anti-pattern callouts). Not a heading substitute.
_MD040: fenced-code-language — some pseudo-code blocks have no language. Mandating a tag would force fake languages.
_MD041:
first-line-h1 — README starts with `

` (banner image) and some references start with metadata blocks before the H1.
